summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for test data organization and documentation in the testing_infrastructure domain. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (which are session_skills in data_source_setup and asset_optimization domains). Peer candidates (AgentOps initialization, test dependency declaration, VCR recording) are in different task families (agent_orchestration, test_orchestration, test_isolation) and do not conflict. The candidate addresses a specific testing best practice supported by the Debugging Roadmap and should be persisted as a new capability.
